title: Direct Knowledge Of Allah 19th Degree 1st Truth From Act To Name Attribute And Essence

questions.question: How many paths, degrees, and truths does this passage say it will mention in a very short way?
questions.answer: It says it will mention two paths, two degrees from those paths, and two truths or details from those degrees.

questions.question: What is the first truth mainly about?
questions.answer: It is about a great ongoing activity that changes and renews everything in the heavens and the earth in an orderly way.

questions.question: What can be noticed within this wise and constant activity?
questions.answer: The rule and care of the Lord can be noticed in it.

questions.question: What is recognized within that caring and merciful rule?
questions.answer: The showing of Allah’s Divinity is recognized there.

questions.question: What do the deeds behind this activity show about the One doing them?
questions.answer: They show that the Doer has full power and complete knowledge.

questions.question: After the deeds of lordly care are noticed, what is perceived next?
questions.answer: Allah’s Names are seen through those deeds.

questions.question: After the Divine Names are understood, what comes next in the passage?
questions.answer: The seven holy attributes are understood from behind the Names.

questions.question: Name the seven attributes mentioned here.
questions.answer: Life, knowledge, power, will, hearing, sight, and speech.

questions.question: What kind of certainty does the heart of faith have about the Necessary Existent in this passage?
questions.answer: It has clear, certain, and obvious faith that He truly exists.

questions.question: How does the passage describe this Necessary Existent at the end of the first paragraph?
questions.answer: As the One God, without equal, eternal, and known by His Names and attributes.

questions.question: What does the passage say is seen all around us in the heavens and the earth?
questions.answer: A mighty, steady, organized reality of action and change is seen everywhere.

questions.question: What happens to beings within this great ongoing action?
questions.answer: They are changed, renewed, and transformed again and again.

questions.question: Why is this activity not described as random?
questions.answer: Because it is presented as wise, ordered, and full of purpose.

questions.question: What does wise activity point to first?
questions.answer: It points to Allah’s lordly care and management.

questions.question: What does lordly care point to after that?
questions.answer: It points to the truth of Divinity.

questions.question: Why does the passage speak of a “veil” when talking about deeds and Names?
questions.answer: It means we understand Allah through what He does and what those actions show, even though we do not see Him with our eyes.

questions.question: What can be understood from the Divine Names shown in all things?
questions.answer: The holy attributes of Allah can be understood from them.

questions.question: According to the passage, how strong is this proof compared with the sun?
questions.answer: It is even clearer and brighter as evidence than the sun.

questions.question: What does the passage say all creation gives testimony to?
questions.answer: It testifies to the seven sacred attributes.

questions.question: What is one main lesson of the whole passage?
questions.answer: The order and wise changes in creation lead a believer to know Allah’s existence, unity, Names, and attributes.

questions.question: In this passage, what is the goal of the paths and degrees being discussed?
questions.answer: The goal is to lead a person to know Allah.

questions.question: What is the first thing the eye notices in the first truth?
questions.answer: It notices a vast and ordered activity that never stops.

questions.question: Where does this activity take place?
questions.answer: It takes place in everything on earth and in the sky.

questions.question: What does this activity reveal about the One behind it?
questions.answer: It reveals that the One behind it acts with knowledge and power.

questions.question: What do the caring and managing actions show after that?
questions.answer: They show the Divine Names.

questions.question: What do the Divine Names help the believer understand next?
questions.answer: They help the believer understand Allah’s sacred attributes.

questions.question: Which attribute in the list shows that Allah knows all things?
questions.answer: The attribute of knowledge.

questions.question: Which two attributes show that nothing escapes Allah’s awareness?
questions.answer: Hearing and sight.

questions.question: What does the mention of will teach about Allah’s actions?
questions.answer: It teaches that His actions are by choice and purpose, not by accident.

questions.question: Why does this chain of signs strengthen iman?
questions.answer: Because it shows step by step that creation points clearly to Allah’s existence, unity, and perfect qualities.

questions.question: What does the passage promise to explain with great shortness?
questions.answer: It promises to briefly explain two ways, two levels of those ways, and two truths connected to them.

questions.question: What quality of the visible world is stressed at the beginning of the first truth?
questions.answer: Its constant, orderly, and powerful movement and renewal are stressed.

questions.question: What idea comes right after the truth of activity?
questions.answer: The truth of dominical care comes after it.

questions.question: What idea comes after dominical care?
questions.answer: The truth of Divinity comes after that.

questions.question: How can a person move in understanding from creation to the Creator in this passage?
questions.answer: By noticing actions, then understanding the Names behind them, and then the attributes behind the Names.

questions.question: What does “Necessary Existent” mean here in simple words?
questions.answer: It means the One whose existence is certain and not dependent on anything else.

questions.question: What does the passage say about Allah’s oneness?
questions.answer: It says He is one and has no equal.

questions.question: What role does faith in the heart have in this passage?
questions.answer: It allows a person to see these truths with certainty.

questions.question: Is the proof in this passage based on one sign or many signs together?
questions.answer: It is based on many signs together across all creation.

questions.question: What is the best summary of the first truth?
questions.answer: The changing and ordered universe shows Allah’s rule, His Names, His attributes, and His certain existence.

questions.question: What three stages of understanding are described before the passage speaks of the Necessary Existent?
questions.answer: First activity is noticed, then lordly care, then Divinity.

questions.question: How is the activity in the universe described?
questions.answer: It is described as ongoing, strong, wise, and orderly.

questions.question: What does the passage say can be discerned from this activity?
questions.answer: The actions of a Doer with perfect power and knowledge can be discerned.

questions.question: What is perceived from behind those actions?
questions.answer: The Divine Names are perceived from behind them.

questions.question: What is deduced from behind the Divine Names?
questions.answer: The seven sacred attributes are deduced.

questions.question: What does the passage mean by saying these attributes are shown by the testimony of all creation?
questions.answer: It means all created things together point to and support these truths.

questions.question: Which attribute means Allah chooses and intends?
questions.answer: The attribute of will.

questions.question: Which attribute means Allah communicates?
questions.answer: The attribute of speech.

questions.question: What feeling should a believer have after reading that the proof is clearer than the sun?
questions.answer: A believer should feel strong certainty and trust in Allah.

questions.question: Why does the passage begin with things we can observe?
questions.answer: Because visible order and change help us understand unseen truths about Allah.

questions.question: According to the passage, what is always happening to beings in the universe?
questions.answer: They are constantly being changed, renewed, and transformed.

questions.question: What does this never-ending change still have, according to the passage?
questions.answer: It still has order, wisdom, and greatness.

questions.question: What truth is seen inside this wise activity?
questions.answer: The truth of Allah’s lordly rule and care is seen inside it.

questions.question: What truth is seen inside that merciful lordly rule?
questions.answer: The truth of Divinity is seen inside it.

questions.question: What kind of Doer is understood from these actions?
questions.answer: A Doer who is all-powerful and all-knowing.

questions.question: What two things are said to appear after the deeds are understood?
questions.answer: First the Divine Names appear, and then the sacred attributes are understood.

questions.question: Which attribute shows that Allah is alive in a perfect and eternal way?
questions.answer: The attribute of life.

questions.question: Which attribute shows that Allah is not unable to do anything?
questions.answer: The attribute of power.

questions.question: What does the passage teach about Allah’s uniqueness?
questions.answer: It teaches that He is one, unmatched, and eternal.

questions.question: If a student had to explain the message of this passage in one sentence, what could he say?
questions.answer: He could say that the wise order and constant renewal in creation clearly show Allah’s existence, oneness, Names, and perfect attributes.
